scientific_integrity: Closed-form all-area proof and independently evaluated Wigner angular integrals. Conventional known spin-Slepian operator and Wigner formulas are credited as input, not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: Exact result only for one complex spin-weight +1 degree-one harmonic space and coaxial antipodal polar caps of total fractional area in (0,1). Does not treat other degrees, freely positioned caps, arbitrary observation regions or multi-chirality fields. Historical priority is provisional; no independent validation is represented.
title: Optimal asymmetric polar-cap allocation for minimal spin-one harmonic observability
